content: In previous sections, we have numerically demonstrated that our model is effective in encouraging useful composition of semantic units. Here, we directly investigate the computed representations for each node of a tree, showing that the remarkable performance of our model is mainly due to the gradual and recursive composition of the intermediate representations on the syntactic structure.
